title: ExamplePress Theme Configuration
description: Declarative configuration for the ExamplePress WordPress theme. Overrides registration defaults; PHP filters still take highest priority.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion.

admin_tabs.description: Control which tabs are visible on the ExamplePress settings page. Companion plugins can also use the examplepress_admin_tabs_hidden filter.

hidden.description: Tab IDs to hide from the settings page navigation.

features.description: Toggle or configure registered theme features. Keys are feature IDs. Values can be a boolean (toggle) or an object with 'enabled' and 'options'.

html5.description: Enable HTML5 markup for core elements. Options: features (array of markup types).

editor-guard.description: Block access to the WordPress Site Editor (admin redirect, REST template endpoints, FSE template resolution). Default: true. Bypassed automatically when EP_DEV_MODE is defined.

disable-remote-block-patterns.description: Prevent loading remote block patterns from the pattern directory.

restrict-block-types.description: Restrict which blocks are available in the editor. Options: types (array of block names).

openverse.description: Show/hide the Openverse media category in the editor.

post-lock-window.description: Set the post lock heartbeat duration in seconds. Options: duration (int).

login-branding.description: Apply custom branding to the WordPress login screen.

theme-colors.description: Inject a colour palette into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.colors instead.

theme-layout.description: Inject layout dimensions into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.layout instead.

theme-typography.description: Inject font families, sizes, and typography flags into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.typography instead.

design-strict.description: Lock down all appearance tools in the editor. Prefer using design.strict instead.

theme-spacing.description: Inject spacing presets, scale, and units into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.spacing instead.

theme-borders.description: Inject border controls and radius presets into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.borders instead.

theme-shadows.description: Inject shadow presets into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.shadows instead.

theme-global-styles.description: Inject global styles (background, text, font, padding) into theme.json at runtime. Prefer using design.globalStyles instead.

blockstudio-assets.description: Control whether Blockstudio assets are enqueued. Prefer using blockstudio.assets instead.

blockstudio-asset-reset.description: Control Blockstudio CSS reset and full-width overrides. Prefer using blockstudio.assetReset instead.

blockstudio-minify.description: Control Blockstudio CSS/JS minification. Prefer using blockstudio.minify instead.

blockstudio-scss.description: Control Blockstudio SCSS processing. Prefer using blockstudio.scss instead.

blockstudio-tailwind.description: Control Blockstudio Tailwind CSS integration. Prefer using blockstudio.tailwind instead.

blockstudio-editor.description: Control Blockstudio editor settings (format on save, assets, markup). Prefer using blockstudio.editor instead.

blockstudio-block-editor.description: Control Blockstudio block editor settings (loading, CSS classes/variables). Prefer using blockstudio.blockEditor instead.

blockstudio-ai-context.description: Toggle Blockstudio AI context generation. Prefer using blockstudio.aiContext instead.

blockstudio-block-tags.description: Control Blockstudio block tag rendering (allow/deny lists). Prefer using blockstudio.blockTags instead.

blockstudio-dev.description: Control Blockstudio developer tools (grab, perf, canvas). Prefer using blockstudio.dev instead.

blockstudio-users.description: Control which users/roles can access Blockstudio. Prefer using blockstudio.users instead.

design.description: Design tokens injected into WordPress theme.json at runtime via wp_theme_json_data_theme.

strict.description: Lock down all appearance tools (custom colors, font sizes, spacing) in the block editor. Forces appearanceTools to false.

colors.description: Colour palette entries. Each maps to a CSS custom property --wp--preset--color--{slug}.

name.description: Human-readable colour name shown in the editor.

slug.description: Slug used in CSS custom properties and class names.

color.description: CSS colour value (hex, rgb, hsl, etc.).

contentSize.description: Maximum width for default content blocks (e.g. '800px').

typography.description: Typography settings injected into theme.json at runtime.

lineHeight.description: Allow custom line-height in the editor.

textColumns.description: Allow text columns in the editor.

writingMode.description: Allow writing mode changes in the editor.

dropCap.description: Show drop cap toggle in the editor.

defaultFontSizes.description: Include WordPress default font size presets.

spacing.description: Spacing settings injected into theme.json at runtime.

units.description: Allowed CSS units for spacing values.

borders.description: Border controls injected into theme.json at runtime.

shadows.description: Shadow presets injected into theme.json at runtime.

globalStyles.description: Global styles (styles.* in theme.json) injected at runtime.

background.description: Global background colour (CSS value or preset reference).

text.description: Global text colour (CSS value or preset reference).

fontFamily.description: Global font family (CSS value or preset reference).

fontSize.description: Global font size (CSS value or preset reference).

padding.description: Global padding values (top, right, bottom, left).

blockstudio.description: Blockstudio runtime settings. Values here are normalised into features.blockstudio-* and applied via blockstudio/settings/* filters.

fullWidth.description: Post types where blocks render full-width.

assets.description: Additional asset paths to load in the editor.

cssClasses.description: Additional CSS class paths to expose.

cssVariables.description: Additional CSS variable paths to expose.

aiContext.description: Toggle Blockstudio AI context generation. Accepts a boolean or object with 'enabled'.

dev.description: Blockstudio developer tools (usually disabled in production).

canvasAdminBar.description: Show admin bar in canvas mode.

users.description: Restrict Blockstudio access to specific users or roles.

ids.description: User IDs that can access Blockstudio.

roles.description: User roles that can access Blockstudio.

docs.description: Documentation links shown in the settings page Docs tab. Client forks can replace these to point at their own documentation.

title.description: Document title shown as the card heading.

description.description: Short summary shown below the title.

category.description: Grouping label shown as an eyebrow above the title (e.g. 'Architecture', 'Configuration').

updater.description: GitHub Releases auto-updater configuration. Controls how the theme checks for and applies updates from the GitHub repository.

asset_filename.description: Filename of the release ZIP asset to download (e.g. 'examplepress-theme.zip').

theme_slug.description: Theme directory slug used for update matching.

default_channel.description: Default update channel. 'stable' only installs full releases; 'prerelease' also includes pre-releases.

requires_wp.description: Minimum WordPress version required for updates (e.g. '6.9').

requires_php.description: Minimum PHP version required for updates (e.g. '8.4').

routing.description: Route origin settings for companion plugins. Controls how this plugin's routes are evaluated relative to other origins in the multi-origin router.

priority.description: Evaluation order for route origins. Lower numbers are evaluated first. 1-5: core routes, 10: default, 20-50: add-ons, 90-99: catch-all/fallback.

routes.description: Declarative route metadata for the admin Route Visualizer. Display-only — does not affect dispatch. The PHP closures in examplepress_register_route_origin() remain the source of truth.

desc.description: Short description of what this route handles.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repo where this app's source lives. Required for Codespaces and Propose Change workflows.

troy.description: Troy Server integration data. Written automatically when an app is connected to a Troy instance via the Build tab.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo associated with this app on Troy.

dependencies.description: Plugins, Composer packages, and libraries required by the theme. Each entry declares a dependency with check type, tier, pricing, source, and optional fallback.

tier.description: How critical this dependency is to the architecture.

cloud_dependent.description: True if primarily a connector for a SaaS/cloud service.

check_type.description: How to detect this dependency: scan the WP plugin registry, check class_exists(), or check function_exists().

check_target.description: The value to check. Defaults to slug for plugins. Use a fully-qualified class name for 'class' or a function name for 'function'.

fallback_slug.description: Slug of a free WordPress.org alternative that satisfies this dependency.
